instruction: An underground subway platform: tiled pillars and curved ceiling, a train arriving with lit windows, yellow warning strip along the platform edge, benches, a route map lightbox, vending machines, hanging signage, stairs with a handrail, and a flickering fluorescent tube. user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Underground Subway Platform. An underground subway platform: tiled pillars and curved ceiling, a train arriving with lit windows, yellow warning strip along the platform edge, benches, a route map lightbox, vending machines, hanging signage, stairs with a handrail, and a flickering fluorescent tube. The train doors align with the platform as air stirs discarded papers. Style: gritty urban realism. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
